edits.model_reason: Clarifies that 'this court' in S2c031f54c36e refers to the Supreme Court, supported by the jurisdictional header in S18189f85fb34.
Removes the incorrect interpretation that Clause 4 applies to dying without issue after the testator's death; it strictly addresses predeceasing the testator.
Corrects the omission of the explicit textual basis in the will connecting the 'no right of transfer' clause to protection against ejection by the elder line/proprietor.
Attributes the priority claim to the Plaintiff's argument rather than stating it as a definitive statutory effect independent of the will's construction.
Removes unsupported speculation about Hindu Law/TPA application, which is outside the provided source material scope.
